scope: Define ETS candidate validity with respect to numerical optimization convergence. No candidate grid, AICc criterion, tie-break, test-time update policy, or final-set rule is changed.
ets_candidate_validity: mle_retvals exists for optimized candidate fitting
invalid_candidate_policy: Treat as candidate failure; log reason; exclude from AICc competition; never substitute or fallback.
justification: An optimized ETS candidate whose numerical optimizer reports failure is not accepted into AICc model selection even when a finite AICc is returned. This rule is frozen before any V2 development or final benchmark.
